videos.title: What If Green Didn't Exist? 🌲➡️⚫
videos.description:
If green light vanished from the universe, every forest would turn black, the sky would glow pink, and Earth might freeze over. But the trees would keep growing. Here's why.

#whatif #science #green #physics #shorts

videos.title: What If You Could Turn Your Weight Down Like Volume? 🎚️
videos.description:
A dial on your wrist that turns your weight down. At half you bounce up the stairs, at a tenth you jump onto roofs, and below 80 grams you float away like a balloon.

#whatif #science #gravity #physics #shorts

videos.title: What If Leveling Up Cost You Years of Your Life? ⏳
videos.description:
Every level up makes you 10% better at anything, and takes one year off the end of your life. Would you press it? The math gets strange fast.

#whatif #levelup #lifespan #science #shorts

videos.title: What If Humans Had a Second Face on the Back of Their Heads? 👀
videos.description:
A second face on the back of your head means no blind spot, no mirrors, and nobody can ever sneak up on you. But nature already ran this experiment, and the answer is surprising.

#whatif #science #biology #evolution #shorts

videos.title: What If Everyone on Earth Ground Their Teeth at the Same Time? 😬
videos.description:
Eight billion people, one countdown, everyone grinds. Would the planet roar? Would Earth shake? The real answer is quieter, and it is already happening every night.

#whatif #science #teeth #physics #shorts

videos.title: What If You Could Sell Your Sleep? 💤
videos.description:
An app buys your sleep by the hour. You feel fine, a billionaire never goes to bed again, and then the bill arrives. So how many hours would you sell?

#whatif #sleep #science #brain #shorts

videos.title: What If You Could Shrink Yourself With a Dial? 🤏
videos.description:
A dial on your wrist shrinks you to one centimetre. You survive any fall, and then the cold, one drop of water and the cat get involved. How small would you dare to go?

#whatif #science #physics #biology #shorts

videos.title: What If You Could Breathe Underwater? 🫧
videos.description:
You wake up with gills and the whole reef is yours, until you start to shiver. The same thin skin that lets oxygen in lets your heat out. Would you still trade your lungs for gills?

#whatif #science #ocean #biology #shorts

videos.title: What If You Lived One Day Inside a Cartoon? ✏️
videos.description:
Thin air holds you until you look down, anvils flatten you and you pop right back. Then midnight hits and real gravity returns. What would you do with one day of cartoon rules?

#whatif #cartoon #physics #animation #shorts

videos.title: What If You Woke Up as a Sponge? 🧽
videos.description:
The loudest person at every party wakes up with no mouth, no legs and no brain, and hosts the biggest party on the reef without feeling a thing. Would you rather be lonely, or be a sponge?

#whatif #science #ocean #biology #shorts

videos.title: What If the Train Came After You? 🚂🐎
videos.description:
You rob a train and ride where no train can follow. So the railroad sends the horses by train.

Just so you know: the outlaw in this story is made up, and it combines two real Wyoming robberies from 1899 and 1900, but the Union Pacific really did build train cars to carry posses and their horses.

#whatif #wildwest #history #train #shorts
